title: lotodes acaule
intro: Lotodes acaule, commonly known as Yellow St. John's Wort, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its numerous health benefits, including treating anxiety, insomnia, and gastrointestinal issues, as well as providing relief from menstrual cramps and other women's health problems. The therapeutic actions of Lotodes acaule include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its traditional uses. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
